note: The source is a composite concept sheet; platform props in the reference panel are not yet separated into individual transparent sprites.
rendering_note: Composite scenery is world-anchored to the camera to keep painted ledges aligned with collision surfaces; a separate low-alpha atmospheric layer moves at a slower parallax rate.
gameplay: Visible roof, balcony, cornice and stair surfaces have authored one-way landing colliders; moving platforms and transitions are drawn separately.
art_note: La ruta tiene doce niveles; Mercado Tapatío, Parque Metropolitano, Andén y Plaza de las Jacarandas tienen fondos originales. La geometría de colisión se reutiliza y valida por separado.
